content: Flux aggregateWindow(every, fn, createEmpty) downsamples each series onto fixed windows; combined with pivot(rowKey:['_time'], columnKey:['_field','_measurement'], valueColumn:'_value') produces one row per aligned timestamp with one column per series -- this is the standard idiom for multi-series time alignment onto a common grid in InfluxDB 2.x. createEmpty:true fills gaps with null so all group members stay row-aligned even with missing samples.
